risks.title: Uncertain tax positions
risks.summary: Uncertain tax positions of $1.3B unrecognized, identified as a Critical Audit Matter by the independent auditor. Exposure to significant future adjustments in case of disputes with tax authorities.
risks.score_rationale: The company has uncertain tax positions for a gross amount of $1.3B unrecognized. Tax authorities could challenge these positions, resulting in significant financial impacts. Identified as a Critical Audit Matter by independent auditor Ernst & Young.

risks.title: Investment impairment
risks.summary: Investments in unlisted securities and partnerships recorded at estimated value using the equity method. Complex valuations without an active market, with value changes directly affecting results.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to impairment risk on investments in unlisted securities and partnerships. Complex valuations and the absence of an active market create significant uncertainty about actual valuations. Changes in partnership investment values directly affect results.

risks.title: Internal controls over financial reporting
risks.summary: Internal controls over financial reporting deemed effective by management and auditor Ernst & Young. No material weaknesses detected as of December 31, 2025.
risks.score_rationale: Management and the independent auditor concluded that internal controls over financial reporting are EFFECTIVE as of December 31, 2025. No deficiencies identified. Audit report: 'maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting'.

risks.title: Currency risks
risks.summary: Exposure to currency risks due to significant international operations (59% of sales). Favorable 2025 impact (+1.0%), but vulnerability to foreign currency volatility.
risks.score_rationale: With 59% of sales from customers outside the United States, the company is exposed to foreign currency fluctuations. Impact observed in 2025: +1.0% (favorable), but risk of future volatility in case of exchange rate changes.

risks.title: Partnership risks
risks.summary: Partnership investments accounted for using the equity method. Value changes directly affect results, creating volatility exposure and requiring complex judgments.
risks.score_rationale: Partnership investments recorded using the equity method at estimated market value. Changes in partnership investment values directly affect results. Complex valuations without an active market, subjective valuation judgments.
